feature: Card captions — the modifiers below the art
note:
The two card views that share `CardTileCaption`: `/collection`'s grid and the deck page's card view. Both draw the same two-line caption at the same fixed height, and the point of the design is that nothing sits on the illustration — so these cells are read for what the ART carries as much as for the caption. `/collection` is addressable (`?view=grid`); the deck's card view is NOT, because the toggle's choice lives in `localStorage` and no URL names it, so that row presses the control.

PRECONDITION, and it is not optional: the account must have `user_prefs.about_version_seen` at or above `ABOUT_VERSION`. Since #658 `proxy.ts` redirects a reader below it to `/about?next=…`, and `contact-sheet.mjs` cannot clear that itself — it signs in with its own helper and reads no database. A gated run photographs the About page and COUNTS THE CELL AS REACHED, because every `wait` resolves inside `<main>` and the About page has content there too. `pnpm probe:card-captions` seeds the flag; run it once against an account before trusting a sheet from this file.

The press is FOLLOWED BY A WAIT, not just a settle. `settle` is a delay and not a readiness check, so a toggle that no-ops or lags leaves the list on screen and the cell is counted as a reached card view — the same way a gated run counts the About page. The third step waits for the caption itself, which only the card view draws.

Each `wait` names something only the finished surface draws, never `h1`: both routes ship a `loading.tsx` whose `LoadingScreen` renders an `<h1>` inside `<main>`, so `h1` resolves against the skeleton the runner's own docblock says it must not photograph. And never `main` itself — steps are already scoped through `onPage`, so that would ask for `main main` and wait out its timeout on a page that had rendered perfectly, which is how the first run of this file failed all four cells.

The picture is the weaker artifact here either way: `pnpm probe:card-captions` MEASURES these surfaces across 24 checks and a contact sheet cannot see a 2px difference. It is here for what measurement cannot do — showing both routes got the feature at all, at both widths.

shares.note: Both routes render it directly — no wrapper — so each row's `view` is the file that imports it. The deck's undo receipt is deliberately NOT a row: it draws no caption of its own, and the `CARD_TILE_CAPTION_H` it borrows is a constant this check would not distinguish from the component.

rows.label: /collection — the grid, captions under bare art
